RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement (the "Lease") is made between Crestline Residential Partners LLC (the "Landlord") and Theo A. Bramhall (the "Resident"). This Lease and the separate documents it names together state the whole of the agreement between the Landlord and the Resident.

1. PARTIES AND PREMISES

1.1 The Landlord leases to the Resident the dwelling unit known as Apartment 12C, 340 Marlowe Court, City of Ashgrove (the "Premises").

1.2 The Premises are let for residential use by the Resident and the members of the Resident's household only.

1.3 The Resident has walked through the Premises and accepts them in the condition they were in on the day of that walk-through.

1.4 The Premises include one refrigerator, one electric range, one dishwasher, and the window blinds that were hanging at the walk-through.

1.5 The Landlord will hand over two keys to the Premises and one key to the building's front door on the first day of the Term.

2. TERM

2.1 The Term of this Lease begins on June 1, 2027 and ends at noon on May 31, 2028.

2.2 The Resident shall return possession of the Premises to the Landlord on or before the last day of the Term.

2.3 If the Resident stays in the Premises after the Term without a signed renewal, the tenancy continues month to month on the same terms until either party gives thirty (30) days written notice.

2.4 A renewal of this Lease must be signed by both the Landlord and the Resident, and neither party is obliged to offer or accept one.

3. RENT

3.1 The Resident shall pay rent of $1,875 per month, due in advance on the first day of each month.

3.2 Rent shall be paid through the Landlord's online payment portal, or by check delivered to the building office during its posted hours.

3.3 Rent received after the fifth day of the month is treated as late, and the late charge stated in the Schedule of Resident Fees is then added to the amount due.

3.4 Acceptance of a partial payment does not waive the Landlord's right to the balance of the rent for that month.

4. RENT CHANGES

4.1 Rent for the Term stated in section 2.1 does not change.

4.2 Rent for any renewal term shall be stated in writing by the Landlord at least forty-five (45) days before the Term ends, and the Resident may accept or decline it.

4.3 If the tenancy continues month to month under section 2.3, the Landlord may change the rent on sixty (60) days written notice.

5. FEES AND CHARGES

5.1 The Resident shall pay the charges set out in the Schedule of Resident Fees, a separate document delivered with this Lease, and that schedule forms part of the agreement between the Landlord and the Resident.

5.2 The Schedule of Resident Fees may be revised by the Landlord once in any twelve month period, on thirty (30) days written notice to the Resident.

5.3 A charge listed in that schedule is due when the event it names occurs, and is collected in the same way as rent.

5.4 The Landlord shall keep a current copy of the schedule posted in the building office.

6. SECURITY DEPOSIT

6.1 The Resident shall pay a security deposit of $1,875 before taking possession of the Premises.

6.2 The Landlord may apply the security deposit to any amount the Resident owes under this Lease or under any document this Lease names, including charges that fall due after the Resident has returned possession.

6.3 The Landlord shall return the balance of the security deposit, with a written itemized statement of every deduction, within thirty (30) days after the Resident returns possession of the Premises.

6.4 The deposit is not rent, and the Resident may not treat it as payment of the last month's rent.

7. UTILITIES

7.1 The Resident shall pay for electricity, gas, internet service, and television service used at the Premises.

7.2 The Landlord shall pay for water, sewer service, and trash collection.

7.3 The Resident shall put the electricity and gas accounts in the Resident's own name before the first day of the Term.

8. REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE

8.1 The Landlord shall keep the roof, the exterior walls, the plumbing, the heating equipment, and the electrical system of the Premises in working order.

8.2 The Resident shall tell the Landlord in writing about any condition in the Premises that needs repair, within five (5) days of noticing it.

8.3 The Resident shall pay for the repair of damage the Resident, a member of the Resident's household, or a guest of the Resident causes.

8.4 The Landlord shall change the furnace filter twice a year, in April and in October, and shall leave a card in the door saying the filter was changed.

9. ACCESS TO THE HOME

9.1 The Landlord may enter the Premises after giving the Resident at least twenty-four (24) hours notice, and only between eight in the morning and six in the evening.

9.2 The Landlord may enter the Premises to show it to prospective residents on any day during the final sixty (60) days of the Term, without notice to the Resident.

9.3 The Landlord may enter without notice when there is a fire, a flood, an escape of gas, or another emergency that threatens the building or a person in it.

10. ANIMALS

10.1 No animal may be kept in the Premises except under the Pet Addendum, a separate document the Resident must sign before an animal enters the Premises.

10.2 The Pet Addendum sets the fees, the deposits, and the conditions that apply to an animal kept in the Premises.

10.3 A service animal or an assistance animal is not an animal for the purposes of this section, and no fee under the Pet Addendum applies to one.

10.4 An animal kept in the Premises without a signed Pet Addendum is a breach of this Lease.

11. ENDING THE LEASE BEFORE THE TERM ENDS

11.1 The Resident may end this Lease before the last day of the Term by giving the Landlord sixty (60) days written notice and paying the charges the Schedule of Resident Fees sets for an early ending.

11.2 The Resident remains responsible for rent through the last day of the notice period given under section 11.1.

11.3 The Landlord shall make a reasonable effort to re-let the Premises after the Resident returns possession.

11.4 A transfer of this Lease to another occupant requires the written consent of the Landlord, which the Landlord shall not unreasonably withhold.

12. DISPUTES

12.1 The Resident agrees that any claim against the Landlord arising out of this Lease must be brought within six (6) months of the event complained of, and gives up any longer period that would otherwise be available.

12.2 A dispute under this Lease may be brought in the courts of the county in which the Premises are located.

12.3 Either party may ask the other in writing to attend one session of mediation before filing a claim, and neither party is obliged to agree.

13. NOTICES

13.1 A notice under this Lease is given in writing, delivered by hand or sent by first class mail to the address the party last gave for notices.

13.2 The Landlord's address for notices is the building office at 340 Marlowe Court, City of Ashgrove.

13.3 The Resident's address for notices is the Premises, unless the Resident gives the Landlord another address in writing.

13.4 A notice sent by mail is treated as given on the third day after it was posted.

14. GENERAL

14.1 This Lease binds the Landlord and the Resident and anyone who takes their place.

14.2 If a court finds any part of this Lease unenforceable, the rest of this Lease continues in force.

14.3 A failure by either party to insist on a term of this Lease on one occasion does not give up that term on a later occasion.

14.4 This Lease is signed in two counterparts, and the Landlord shall give the Resident one of them on the day the Term begins.

14.5 The Resident may hang pictures on the walls using nails no wider than the width of a pencil lead, and shall fill the holes before returning possession.

15. INSURANCE

15.1 The Resident shall keep renter's insurance covering the Resident's own belongings for the whole of the Term, in an amount of at least $15,000.

15.2 The Resident shall name the Landlord as an interested party on that policy and shall give the Landlord a copy of the certificate before the first day of the Term.

15.3 The Landlord's insurance covers the building and does not cover the Resident's belongings.

15.4 If the Resident lets the policy lapse, the Landlord may buy a policy covering the building's interest alone and charge the Resident for it at the rate the Schedule of Resident Fees states.

16. PARKING AND STORAGE

16.1 One uncovered parking space in the lot behind the building is included with the Premises, and the Landlord will mark it with the number of the Premises.

16.2 A second space, and a storage locker in the basement, may be rented at the monthly rates set out in the Schedule of Resident Fees.

16.3 The Resident shall not keep a vehicle in the lot that is unregistered, has a flat tire, or has not moved in thirty (30) days.

16.4 The Landlord may have a vehicle that breaks section 16.3 towed after leaving a written warning on the vehicle for seventy-two (72) hours.

17. CONDUCT IN THE BUILDING

17.1 The Resident shall not make noise that can be heard in another dwelling unit between ten in the evening and seven in the morning.

17.2 The Resident shall not smoke anywhere inside the building, including inside the Premises, and shall not allow a guest to do so.

17.3 The Resident shall break down cardboard boxes before putting them in the building's recycling bins.

17.4 The Resident shall not run a business from the Premises that brings members of the public to the building.

SIGNED by the Landlord and the Resident on May 12, 2027.
